summary.text: Each year, eligibility is checked automatically. No application is needed. Eligible members are notified at the beginning of each year.

details.heading: Automatic yearly assessment
details.body: Your eligibility is checked automatically every year. You do not need to apply.

details.heading: When you will be notified
details.body: If you are eligible, you will be notified at the beginning of each year by email or post.

details.heading: Check your eligibility
details.body: You can also check your eligibility using the Healthcare dashboard.

example_phrasings: When will my eligibility for the Matched MediSave Scheme be assessed and do I need to apply?
Do I need to apply for MMSS?
When will CPF check if I qualify for MMSS?

sources.page_title: When will my eligibility for the Matched MediSave Scheme be assessed and do I need to apply?

quotes.text: Members’ eligibility for the Matched MediSave Scheme (MMSS) will be automatically assessed annually. You do not need to apply for the scheme.
You will be notified at the beginning of each year if you are eligible for the scheme for the year via email or post.
You can also check your eligibility for the MMSS via the Healthcare dashboard.
